title: How A Paradise Became A Death Trap: An Update

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·朗森，欢迎收听《重塑者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其背后文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使是在我那个黑胶唱片时代的夜店打碟时期，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每晚都要带着300件最珍贵的宝贝去工作，把DJ台变成一个充满50年历史精美文物的流动博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼带来的《重塑者》吧。

sentences.en: Hey, it's Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是萨布丽娜。

sentences.en: This week, The Daily is revisiting some of our favorite episodes of the year, listening back, and then hearing what's happened in the time since they first ran.
sentences.zh: 本周，《每日新闻》将重温我们今年最喜欢的一些剧集，回顾过去，并了解它们首次播出后发生的事情。

sentences.en: Today, the fire that devastated Lahaina, Hawaii, in August, and one man's story of surviving it.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们要讲述的是八月份摧毁夏威夷拉海纳的那场大火，以及一名幸存者的故事。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, December 26th.
sentences.zh: 今天是12月26日，星期二。

sentences.en: Hi, is this Idris?
sentences.zh: 你好，是伊德里斯吗？

sentences.en: Yes, it is.
sentences.zh: 是的，是我。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Idris, thank you for taking the time to talk to us.
sentences.zh: 伊德里斯，谢谢你抽出时间接受我们的采访。

sentences.en: And I wonder, Idris, if you could introduce yourself for me.
sentences.zh: 我想请你先做个自我介绍。

sentences.en: Tell me your name, your age, where you live, and what your profession is.
sentences.zh: 告诉我你的名字、年龄、住址以及你的职业。

sentences.en: I'm Nora, 32 years old.
sentences.zh: 我是诺拉，今年32岁。

sentences.en: I lived on Prison Street in Maui, Lahaina.
sentences.zh: 我住在茂宜岛拉海纳的监狱街。

sentences.en: And I was the manager at a Hilton property of the Beach and Pool.
sentences.zh: 我之前在希尔顿酒店的海滩和泳池部门担任经理。

sentences.en: I work in sales.
sentences.zh: 我从事销售工作。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And I wonder if you could start by telling us, just kind of from the beginning, how your day started.
sentences.zh: 我想请你从头开始讲起，你那天是怎么开始的？

sentences.en: So, actually, it was my first true day off in a long time.
sentences.zh: 其实，那是我很久以来第一个真正的休息日。

sentences.en: And I woke up in the middle of the night, which was Monday night, Tuesday morning, around 3 or 4 a.m., when we lost power.
sentences.zh: 我在半夜醒来，那是周一晚上到周二凌晨，大约三四点钟，当时我们停电了。

sentences.en: So, it got pretty hot.
sentences.zh: 屋里变得很热。

sentences.en: So, I opened up the windows.
sentences.zh: 所以我打开了窗户。

sentences.en: And by the time I woke up around 6, 7 a.m., I noticed we didn't have service, neither.
sentences.zh: 等到我早上六七点醒来时，我发现手机也没信号了。

sentences.en: Self-service.
sentences.zh: 没信号。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And honestly, I was just annoyed.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我当时只是觉得很烦。

sentences.en: I was like, I've been waiting for this day off forever.
sentences.zh: 我想着，我等这个休息日等了太久了。

sentences.en: And no power.
sentences.zh: 结果还没电。

sentences.en: You know, we didn't even know it was a hurricane.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们甚至不知道那是飓风。

sentences.en: We just thought it was windy.
sentences.zh: 我们只以为风很大。

sentences.en: And were you aware of the fire at that point?
sentences.zh: 那时候你意识到有火灾了吗？

sentences.en: Oh, absolutely not.
sentences.zh: 哦，绝对没有。

sentences.en: There was no fire in the morning that I was aware of.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，早上并没有火灾。

sentences.en: We had no warnings at all.
sentences.zh: 我们根本没有任何预警。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And I said, there's another fire.
sentences.zh: 然后我说，又着火了。

sentences.en: And it was closer.
sentences.zh: 而且离得更近了。

sentences.en: It was actually the street behind us.
sentences.zh: 其实就在我们身后的那条街上。

sentences.en: And I had a scooter.
sentences.zh: 我有一辆滑板车。

sentences.en: So, I actually went to go check out how close the fire was.
sentences.zh: 所以我骑车去看了看火势有多近。

sentences.en: And I got on Front Street, which is a street that goes along, you know, the ocean.
sentences.zh: 我到了前街，那是一条沿着海边的街道。

sentences.en: And I see there's this restaurant up in flames.
sentences.zh: 我看到一家餐馆燃起了大火。

sentences.en: And I saw people running.
sentences.zh: 我看到人们在奔跑。

sentences.en: And straight in front of me, there's a medical center.
sentences.zh: 在我正前方，有一个医疗中心。

sentences.en: And I remember, actually, seeing a lot of people trying to get in the medical center.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时看到很多人试图进入那个医疗中心。

sentences.en: Then behind me, there's a whole business on fire.
sentences.zh: 然后在我身后，整家商铺都着火了。

sentences.en: I was like, holy, like, everything was on fire.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，天哪，到处都在着火。

sentences.en: Like, I didn't understand how things started to catch on fire.
sentences.zh: 我不明白为什么东西会突然着火。

sentences.en: It didn't make sense.
sentences.zh: 这根本说不通。

sentences.en: And now I started to panic.
sentences.zh: 现在我开始恐慌了。

sentences.en: So, I went back to the neighbors.
sentences.zh: 所以我回到邻居家。

sentences.en: But the neighbors were all gone.
sentences.zh: 但邻居们都不见了。

sentences.en: I felt kind of loSt. And the wind, you know, there was wind and there was trees falling down.
sentences.zh: 我感到很迷茫。风很大，树木不断倒下。

sentences.en: And I screamed for my cat.
sentences.zh: 我大声呼唤我的猫。

sentences.en: And I saw her run under the house.
sentences.zh: 我看到她跑到了房子下面。

sentences.en: And she didn't want to come out.
sentences.zh: 她不肯出来。

sentences.en: So, I was panicking.
sentences.zh: 所以我很恐慌。

sentences.en: You know, reality started to set in.
sentences.zh: 你知道，现实开始显现了。

sentences.en: And so, I said, okay, maybe, you know, the safest place to be right now is here.
sentences.zh: 所以我对自己说，好吧，也许现在最安全的地方就是这里。

sentences.en: Because I wouldn't even know where to go.
sentences.zh: 因为我根本不知道该往哪儿跑。

sentences.en: And so, I'm closing the door.
sentences.zh: 于是我关上了门。

sentences.en: And about five minutes, everything turned black outside.
sentences.zh: 大约五分钟后，外面的一切都变黑了。

sentences.en: And a medical center across the street was up and slain to the sky.
sentences.zh: 街对面的医疗中心瞬间冲天大火。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: And I couldn't understand.
sentences.zh: 我无法理解。

sentences.en: I said, how?
sentences.zh: 我说，怎么会？

sentences.en: Like, I just felt people, like, there was nothing, like, five, ten minutes ago.
sentences.zh: 五到十分钟前明明什么都没有，我感觉人们都在那儿。

sentences.en: And it really looked like someone put gasoline all over the building and it just, like, took up and slain.
sentences.zh: 看起来就像有人在整栋建筑上泼了汽油，瞬间就烧起来了。

sentences.en: And it didn't make sense how, like, a stone building could burn so faSt.
sentences.zh: 石造建筑怎么可能烧得这么快，这根本说不通。

sentences.en: And so, I opened the door, still calling my cat.
sentences.zh: 于是我打开门，继续叫我的猫。

sentences.en: And I felt something burning on my shoulder.
sentences.zh: 我感觉到肩膀上有东西在烧。

sentences.en: And it was debris, like, amber.
sentences.zh: 那是碎片，像余烬一样。

sentences.en: And I look up in the sky and there's literally fire coming down the sky.
sentences.zh: 我抬头看天，火真的是从天上掉下来的。

sentences.en: It was raining fire.
sentences.zh: 那是在下火雨。

sentences.en: And now, I said, I have to get out of here.
sentences.zh: 现在我说，我必须离开这里。

sentences.en: And so, you know, I got everything I could, you know, all the necessities, clothes and wallet and, you know, pictures or whatever.
sentences.zh: 于是我拿上了所有能拿的东西，必需品、衣服、钱包，还有照片之类的。

sentences.en: And put everything in two big bags.
sentences.zh: 把所有东西装进两个大袋子里。

sentences.en: And I ran out of the house.
sentences.zh: 我跑出了房子。

sentences.en: And as I ran out of the house, there was smoke everywhere.
sentences.zh: 当我跑出房子时，到处都是烟。

sentences.en: And I saw one of my neighbors coughing.
sentences.zh: 我看到一个邻居在咳嗽。

sentences.en: He was right in front of the house.
sentences.zh: 他就站在房子前面。

sentences.en: And he was just coughing.
sentences.zh: 他一直在咳嗽。

sentences.en: And I said, what are you doing here?
sentences.zh: 我说，你在这里干什么？

sentences.en: He's like, oh, I went to the store.
sentences.zh: 他说，哦，我刚去商店回来。

sentences.en: And I said, okay, let's get on my scooter.
sentences.zh: 我说，好吧，快上我的滑板车。

sentences.en: So, he came behind me on my scooter.
sentences.zh: 于是他坐到了我的滑板车后座。

sentences.en: And the fire came from uphill.
sentences.zh: 火是从山上烧下来的。

sentences.en: It was coming down.
sentences.zh: 它正在逼近。

sentences.en: So, to me, the safest place of this fire is water.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，躲避这场火灾最安全的地方就是水里。

sentences.en: And so, you know, in the panic, I said, we have to go to the harbor.
sentences.zh: 在恐慌中，我说，我们必须去港口。

sentences.en: And then we got on front street.
sentences.zh: 然后我们到了前街。

sentences.en: And on front street, I was just chaos.
sentences.zh: 前街上简直是一片混乱。

sentences.en: I could hear, you know, screaMs.
sentences.zh: 我能听到尖叫声。

sentences.en: And then I couldn't see people, but I could hear them scream.
sentences.zh: 我看不到人，但我能听到他们的尖叫。

sentences.en: Scary screaMs.
sentences.zh: 可怕的尖叫。

sentences.en: Screams of pain I've never heard before.
sentences.zh: 我从未听过的那种痛苦的尖叫。

sentences.en: There were clearly people burning alive.
sentences.zh: 显然有人正在被活活烧死。

sentences.en: Like, it was a deep pain, you know.
sentences.zh: 那是一种深层的痛苦。

sentences.en: And people throwing up.
sentences.zh: 还有人在呕吐。

sentences.en: And it was just, it was horrifying.
sentences.zh: 那场面太恐怖了。

sentences.en: It was horrifying to hear that.
sentences.zh: 听到那些声音真是太可怕了。

sentences.en: I'm so glad I couldn't see.
sentences.zh: 我很庆幸我看不见。

sentences.en: It was so, it was black because there was so much smoke.
sentences.zh: 因为烟雾太浓，四周一片漆黑。

sentences.en: But we could clearly hear them all around us.
sentences.zh: 但我们能清楚地听到他们就在我们周围。

sentences.en: All around us.
sentences.zh: 就在我们周围。

sentences.en: It felt like we were in hell.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像身处地狱。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 430 in the morning, and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点30分给总统打了电话，他接听了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 太空探索的七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today, I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天，我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最强的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用不同的起始词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one-pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢一锅出的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝成立175周年，致力于帮助您了解世界，充分利用每一天。

sentences.zh: 现在订阅可享受特别优惠，请访问 nytimes.com/subscribe。

sentences.en: The wind itself, the wind was the scariest thing.
sentences.zh: 风本身，风才是最可怕的东西。

sentences.en: The wind was so hot, it was burning our skin.
sentences.zh: 风太热了，烧得我们的皮肤生疼。

sentences.en: It was so strong because everything was on fire.
sentences.zh: 因为它太强劲了，而且到处都在着火。

sentences.en: And I told Damon, you got to tell me when to turn to the harbor because I can't see nothing.
sentences.zh: 我告诉达蒙，你得告诉我什么时候转弯去港口，因为我什么都看不见。

sentences.en: And so we finally got to the harbor.
sentences.zh: 我们终于到了港口。

sentences.en: And I left my scooter there and at the edge of the water on the harbor, there's a little house, little, it's called the Harbor Master's Hub.
sentences.zh: 我把滑板车留在那儿，在港口水边有一座小房子，叫港务长中心。

sentences.en: So we had our back against the wall and we were facing the ocean.
sentences.zh: 我们背靠着墙，面向大海。

sentences.en: And we're just waiting.
sentences.zh: 我们只能等待。

sentences.en: We just didn't know what to do.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道该怎么办。

sentences.en: Did you say anything to him?
sentences.zh: 你对他说了什么吗？

sentences.en: No, we were not talking.
sentences.zh: 没有，我们没说话。

sentences.en: We didn't know.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道。

sentences.en: I mean, in my mind, I'm like, okay, we're going to wait here at leaSt.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我心里想的是，好吧，至少我们在这里等着。

sentences.en: Like, we're not going to burn.
sentences.zh: 至少我们不会被烧死。

sentences.en: That's what I was thinking.
sentences.zh: 我当时就是这么想的。

sentences.en: But a couple minutes waiting there, I saw a shadow just run and jump in the water on the side of the house.
sentences.zh: 但在那里等了几分钟后，我看到一个黑影跑过来，跳进了房子旁边的水里。

sentences.en: And I said, Damon, do you see this?
sentences.zh: 我说，达蒙，你看到了吗？

sentences.en: And we look in the water, there's a big pit bull just drowning in front of us.
sentences.zh: 我们往水里看，有一只大比特犬就在我们面前溺水。

sentences.en: You know, he had the big head and yellow eyes.
sentences.zh: 你知道，它有着大大的脑袋和黄色的眼睛。

sentences.en: And I didn't know, I wanted to help him, but I didn't know if he was going to bite me or pull him with him in the water.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，我想救它，但我不知道它会不会咬我，或者把我一起拖进水里。

sentences.en: You know, so I kept calling him and calling him, but he couldn't do it.
sentences.zh: 我一直在呼唤它，但它做不到。

sentences.en: He tried his best to do it, but he couldn't do it.
sentences.zh: 它尽力了，但还是不行。

sentences.en: And I'll never forget the look he gave me in his eyes.
sentences.zh: 我永远不会忘记它看着我的眼神。

sentences.en: I was like, he just gave up and his head went underwater.
sentences.zh: 它好像放弃了，头沉进了水里。

sentences.en: And I told Damon to hold my feet.
sentences.zh: 我让达蒙抓住我的脚。

sentences.en: And I took my shirt off and I somehow managed to grab him by the collar and pull him out.
sentences.zh: 我脱下衬衫，设法抓住了它的项圈，把它拉了上来。

sentences.en: And we tried to calm him down.
sentences.zh: 我们试着让他冷静下来。

sentences.en: He was just walking in circles.
sentences.zh: 他只是在原地转圈。

sentences.en: He was in panic mode.
sentences.zh: 他当时陷入了恐慌。

sentences.en: And then I called the police.
sentences.zh: 然后我打了报警电话。

sentences.en: And I said, hey, we're on the harbor.
sentences.zh: 我说，嘿，我们在港口。

sentences.en: We're stuck.
sentences.zh: 我们被困住了。

sentences.en: You guys have to come get us.
sentences.zh: 你们得过来接我们。

sentences.en: And the lady was just, she didn't know what to say.
sentences.zh: 那位女士当时也不知道该说什么。

sentences.en: She said, I'm sorry, we can't come get you.
sentences.zh: 她说，抱歉，我们没法过去接你们。

sentences.en: Everything was in flames and they were overwhelmed.
sentences.zh: 到处都在着火，他们也应接不暇。

sentences.en: I hung up.
sentences.zh: 我挂断了电话。

sentences.en: And I just remember seeing debris falling from the sky.
sentences.zh: 我只记得看到碎片从天而降。

sentences.en: And our bag kept catching on fire.
sentences.zh: 我们的包一直在着火。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Miraculously, I saw on my phone, I had one bar of service.
sentences.zh: 奇迹般地，我看到手机有一格信号。

sentences.en: So I tried to call my best friend, Yassine.
sentences.zh: 于是我试着打给我的挚友亚辛。

sentences.en: And I told my best friend, hey, I love you.
sentences.zh: 我告诉他，嘿，我爱你。

sentences.en: Tell everybody I love them.
sentences.zh: 告诉大家我爱他们。

sentences.en: It's going to be okay.
sentences.zh: 一切都会好起来的。

sentences.en: You know, here's my mom's number.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是我妈妈的号码。

sentences.en: Don't call her now.
sentences.zh: 现在别打给她。

sentences.en: Wait, you know, let her sleep.
sentences.zh: 等等，你知道的，让她睡吧。

sentences.en: Were you preparing because you thought you might not make it?
sentences.zh: 你当时是在做准备，因为你觉得可能活不下去了吗？

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: We didn't think we were going to make it.
sentences.zh: 我们当时觉得活不成了。

sentences.en: And after I hung up with him, I called the police again.
sentences.zh: 和他挂断电话后，我又打了一次报警电话。

sentences.en: And she gave me the same answer.
sentences.zh: 她给我的回答还是一样。

sentences.en: She said, I'm so sorry.
sentences.zh: 她说，我真的很抱歉。

sentences.en: And, you know, I could feel the frustration in her voice.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我能感觉到她声音里的挫败感。

sentences.en: She was just helpless.
sentences.zh: 她当时也很无助。

sentences.en: She didn't know.
sentences.zh: 她也不知道该怎么办。

sentences.en: And I felt so bad for her because she probably had so many calls like this.
sentences.zh: 我真的很同情她，因为她可能接到了很多这样的求救电话。

sentences.en: And so I hung up again and I was just frustrated.
sentences.zh: 所以我又挂了电话，感到非常沮丧。

sentences.en: So at this point, I thought maybe I could get into Harbor Master's Hut, the little house.
sentences.zh: 当时我想，也许我能进到港务长的小屋里去。

sentences.en: Damon had a knife with him and he cut the screen off.
sentences.zh: 达蒙带着一把刀，他把纱窗割开了。

sentences.en: And I started punching the window with all my strength, all my strength.
sentences.zh: 我用尽全身力气去砸窗户，用尽了全身力气。

sentences.en: And so I fractured my hand.
sentences.zh: 结果我的手骨折了。

sentences.en: The window was so thick, it wouldn't even do anything.
sentences.zh: 窗户太厚了，根本砸不动。

sentences.en: And so I called the police a third time.
sentences.zh: 于是我第三次打了报警电话。

sentences.en: And I said, if you guys don't come right now, we're going to die.
sentences.zh: 我说，如果你们现在不来，我们就要死了。

sentences.en: And she said, you guys have to jump in the water.
sentences.zh: 她说，你们必须跳进水里。

sentences.en: And I said, no way.
sentences.zh: 我说，绝不可能。

sentences.en: You want to jump in a hurricane at night with all this smoke?
sentences.zh: 你想让我们在晚上跳进飓风里，而且到处都是烟？

sentences.en: Like, there's no way we can jump.
sentences.zh: 我们根本不可能跳下去。

sentences.en: The water was crazy.
sentences.zh: 水里的情况太疯狂了。

sentences.en: And she said, you have no choice.
sentences.zh: 她说，你们别无选择。

sentences.en: You have to jump in the water.
sentences.zh: 你们必须跳进水里。

sentences.en: And I hung up and I looked at Damon.
sentences.zh: 我挂了电话，看着达蒙。

sentences.en: I was like, we have to jump.
sentences.zh: 我说，我们必须跳。

sentences.en: And Damon said, there's no way I'm jumping.
sentences.zh: 达蒙说，我绝不会跳的。

sentences.en: I'm not jumping.
sentences.zh: 我不会跳的。

sentences.en: I told him, listen, either we burn or we drown.
sentences.zh: 我告诉他，听着，要么被火烧死，要么被水淹死。

sentences.en: And, you know, I waited a couple more minutes.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我又等了几分钟。

sentences.en: I tried to convince him.
sentences.zh: 我试着说服他。

sentences.en: And I said, you know, I'm jumping.
sentences.zh: 我说，你知道，我要跳了。

sentences.en: There were rocks maybe 100 feet away or 150 feet.
sentences.zh: 大概一百五十英尺外有岩石。

sentences.en: And I finally made it.
sentences.zh: 我最终成功了。

sentences.en: And I looked back and I screamed at Damon.
sentences.zh: 我回头冲达蒙大喊。

sentences.en: And he was just terrified.
sentences.zh: 他当时吓坏了。

sentences.en: He was not, you know, he was next to the dog.
sentences.zh: 他当时，你知道，他就在狗旁边。

sentences.en: And I told him, jump.
sentences.zh: 我告诉他，跳啊。

sentences.en: And I kept screaming.
sentences.zh: 我一直在喊。

sentences.en: And he just didn't want to.
sentences.zh: 但他就是不想跳。

sentences.en: And I could see him hanging on to the harbor with half his body in the water.
sentences.zh: 我看到他抓着港口，半个身子都在水里。

sentences.en: And I kept screaming, you need to let go.
sentences.zh: 我一直在喊，你得松手。

sentences.en: You need to let go.
sentences.zh: 你得松手。

sentences.en: And he screamed, my shoes are too heavy.
sentences.zh: 他尖叫道，我的鞋子太重了。

sentences.en: And so I just made the decision to jump and go get him.
sentences.zh: 所以我决定跳回去救他。

sentences.en: So I got back in the water.
sentences.zh: 于是我回到了水里。

sentences.en: And I got back next to him.
sentences.zh: 我回到了他身边。

sentences.en: I tried to go and take his shoes off.
sentences.zh: 我试着去帮他脱掉鞋子。

sentences.en: I can't even find his feet.
sentences.zh: 我甚至摸不到他的脚。

sentences.en: The ocean would just push him against the wall.
sentences.zh: 海水一直把他往墙上推。

sentences.en: And I told him, you have to follow me.
sentences.zh: 我告诉他，你必须跟着我。

sentences.en: I see.
sentences.zh: 我明白了。

sentences.en: And the way he was swimming, I said, there's no way he's going to make it.
sentences.zh: 看他游泳的样子，我说，他绝对活不成了。

sentences.en: But he was just struggling, just swallowing water and coughing.
sentences.zh: 但他一直在挣扎，不停地呛水和咳嗽。

sentences.en: And somehow he managed to get very close to the rock and I pulled him up.
sentences.zh: 不知怎么的，他设法靠近了岩石，我把他拉了上来。

sentences.en: You know, he's overweight and he's, you know, older.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他超重了，而且，你知道，年纪也大了。

sentences.en: It was a miracle.
sentences.zh: 那真是个奇迹。

sentences.en: And, you know, we still had debris falling on us.
sentences.zh: 你知道，碎片还在不断掉在我们身上。

sentences.en: And we had waves just coming over us.
sentences.zh: 海浪也一直拍打着我们。

sentences.en: We were holding onto the rocks to not, like, get pulled or sucked in by the ocean.
sentences.zh: 我们紧紧抓住岩石，以免被海水卷走。

sentences.en: It was just a nightmare.
sentences.zh: 那简直是一场噩梦。

sentences.en: And then I heard a dog screaming.
sentences.zh: 然后我听到有狗在叫。

sentences.en: So I was like, I have to go back.
sentences.zh: 所以我心想，我必须回去。

sentences.en: And I jumped back in the water.
sentences.zh: 我又跳回了水里。

sentences.en: You know, I tried to get back on the harbor.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我试着回到港口。

sentences.en: He was laying against the wall.
sentences.zh: 他靠在墙边躺着。

sentences.en: His eyes closed.
sentences.zh: 闭着眼睛。

sentences.en: And he was screaming.
sentences.zh: 它在尖叫。

sentences.en: And there's no way I could care.
sentences.zh: 我根本没法管它。

sentences.en: It was a big pit bull.
sentences.zh: 那是一只大比特犬。

sentences.en: And I had one, you know, and my hand was fractured or broken.
sentences.zh: 我当时，你知道，我的手骨折了。

sentences.en: So I thought, if I try to grab him in the water, he's already freaked out.
sentences.zh: 所以我想，如果我在水里去抓它，它已经吓坏了。

sentences.en: We're both going to drown.
sentences.zh: 我们俩都会淹死。

sentences.en: You know, he's going to die for sure.
sentences.zh: 你知道，它肯定会死。

sentences.en: And I'm probably not going to make it.
sentences.zh: 而且我可能也活不成了。

sentences.en: So in one of my bags, I had a blanket.
sentences.zh: 所以，在我的一个包里，有一条毯子。

sentences.en: And I dipped it in the ocean five or six times.
sentences.zh: 我把它在海里浸了五六次。

sentences.en: And I put it on top of the dog.
sentences.zh: 然后我把它盖在狗身上。

sentences.en: That's all I could do.
sentences.zh: 我只能做到这些了。

sentences.en: And I took one of my bags.
sentences.zh: 我拿上我的一个包。

sentences.en: And I jumped back in the ocean.
sentences.zh: 又跳回了海里。

sentences.en: And then I almost drowned.
sentences.zh: 然后我差点淹死。

sentences.en: I was just so exhausted.
sentences.zh: 我当时精疲力竭。

sentences.en: And I panicked halfway.
sentences.zh: 中途我陷入了恐慌。

sentences.en: And I was praying to God, please help me.
sentences.zh: 我向上帝祈祷，请救救我。

sentences.en: And I thanked God I made it to the jetty.
sentences.zh: 我感谢上帝，我终于到了防波堤。

sentences.en: And I went back on the other side.
sentences.zh: 我回到了另一边。

sentences.en: And I talked to Damon.
sentences.zh: 我跟达蒙说话。

sentences.en: He was not answering.
sentences.zh: 他没有回应。

sentences.en: And I grabbed his hand.
sentences.zh: 我抓住了他的手。

sentences.en: He just held my hand.
sentences.zh: 他紧紧握住我的手。

sentences.en: He was just in shock.
sentences.zh: 他当时处于休克状态。

sentences.en: And then maybe an hour after that, I saw a light, you know, far away.
sentences.zh: 大约一小时后，我看到远处有一道光。

sentences.en: And I told Damon, I said, hey, I think there's a boat over there.
sentences.zh: 我告诉达蒙，嘿，我想那边有艘船。

sentences.en: And we were, like, screaming.
sentences.zh: 我们当时在大喊。

sentences.en: I was screaming at the top of my lungs.
sentences.zh: 我用尽全身力气大喊。

sentences.en: And they were, like, coming towards us.
sentences.zh: 他们正朝我们过来。

sentences.en: I was like, thank God.
sentences.zh: 我心想，谢天谢地。

sentences.en: And it was the Coast Guard.
sentences.zh: 那是海岸警卫队。

sentences.en: And they were, like, we can't get close.
sentences.zh: 他们说，我们没法靠近。

sentences.en: You guys have to jump in the water, you know, because it was so rough.
sentences.zh: 你们得跳进水里，因为风浪太大了。

sentences.en: They were crashing the rocks.
sentences.zh: 他们正撞向岩石。

sentences.en: And I jumped firSt.
sentences.zh: 我先跳了下去。

sentences.en: And they got me in.
sentences.zh: 他们把我拉了上去。

sentences.en: I just laid down on my back.
sentences.zh: 我只是平躺在背上。

sentences.en: And I could just see amber just falling on us.
sentences.zh: 我能看到余烬不断落在我们身上。

sentences.en: Like, the sky had no stars.
sentences.zh: 天空没有星星。

sentences.en: The amber was the stars.
sentences.zh: 余烬就是星星。

sentences.en: Red stars in the sky.
sentences.zh: 天空中红色的星星。

sentences.en: That's what it looked like.
sentences.zh: 看起来就是那样。

sentences.en: Just a black sky with red stars just falling down.
sentences.zh: 漆黑的天空，红色的星星不断落下。

sentences.en: I was falling on the ocean, but I felt like I was falling in space.
sentences.zh: 我当时掉进海里，但感觉像是掉进了太空。

sentences.en: I was thanking God.
sentences.zh: 我在感谢上帝。

sentences.en: I was like, thank you, thank you, thank you.
sentences.zh: 我说，谢谢，谢谢，谢谢。

sentences.en: I don't deserve this.
sentences.zh: 我不配得到这些。

sentences.en: I really just, it was just unbelievable that we made it.
sentences.zh: 我真的，我们能活下来简直不可思议。

sentences.en: And Damon, man, he managed to make it.
sentences.zh: 还有达蒙，天哪，他居然也活下来了。

sentences.en: And I was like, thank God.
sentences.zh: 我心想，谢天谢地。

sentences.en: We made it.
sentences.zh: 我们活下来了。

sentences.en: And I said, oh, how did you guys find us?
sentences.zh: 我说，哦，你们是怎么找到我们的？

sentences.en: And they said, we got a call that someone might be on the harbor.
sentences.zh: 他们说，我们接到电话说有人可能在港口。

sentences.en: So I think that lady, you know, she relayed the call and finally got to us.
sentences.zh: 我想那位女士，你知道，她转达了电话，最终找到了我们。

sentences.en: And I said, thank God we made it.
sentences.zh: 我说，谢天谢地我们活下来了。

sentences.en: And he said, oh, no, not yet.
sentences.zh: 他说，哦，不，还没结束。

sentences.en: We still have to go through the storm.
sentences.zh: 我们还得穿过风暴。

sentences.en: And I said, where are we going?
sentences.zh: 我说，我们要去哪儿？

sentences.en: And he said, we don't know.
sentences.zh: 他说，我们不知道。

sentences.en: Everything's on fire.
sentences.zh: 到处都在着火。

sentences.en: And I looked behind me and there was just, it was just, it looked like war.
sentences.zh: 我回头一看，那景象，简直就像战争一样。

sentences.en: It was just flames up to the sky, the whole, I mean, the whole town in the darkness.
sentences.zh: 火焰直冲云霄，整个，我是说，整个小镇都陷入了黑暗之中。

sentences.en: So we got to Maui High School.
sentences.zh: 于是我们赶到了毛伊高中。

sentences.en: They made a shelter there.
sentences.zh: 他们在那里设立了避难所。

sentences.en: And then when we arrived, of course, we were like covering suit and all black.
sentences.zh: 当我们到达时，当然，我们看起来浑身是灰，全身漆黑。

sentences.en: So everyone was looking at us and I was barefoot.
sentences.zh: 所以每个人都在看我们，而且我还是赤着脚的。

sentences.en: The people kept staring at my feet.
sentences.zh: 人们一直盯着我的脚看。

sentences.en: Everybody knew, you know, we're the ones who survived.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，我们是幸存者。

sentences.en: You know, everybody that was in the shelter or the lucky ones.
sentences.zh: 你知道，避难所里的每个人，或者说那些幸运儿。

sentences.en: After the break, senior producer Lindsay Garrison shares an update on Idris, a survivor of Lahaina's fire.
sentences.zh: 休息过后，资深制作人琳赛·加里森将带来拉海纳火灾幸存者伊德里斯的最新消息。

sentences.en: I'm Wynna Lowe.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·洛。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏板块中的《Connections》游戏。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我热爱恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我也喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天负责创作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像你们刚才听到的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 即可开始游戏。

sentences.en: Feel very fresh.
sentences.zh: 感觉非常新鲜。

sentences.en: Really, honestly, to this day, it feels like it was yesterday.
sentences.zh: 说实话，直到今天，感觉就像昨天发生的一样。

sentences.en: You know, I'm at a hotel and no one knows what's next, actually.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我住在酒店里，实际上没人知道接下来会怎样。

sentences.en: I called Idris back in late November.
sentences.zh: 我在去年十一月下旬回访了伊德里斯。

sentences.en: He talked to me from a hotel.
sentences.zh: 他在酒店里和我通了话。

sentences.en: He said he'd been living in hotels for more than three months, waiting for FEMA to secure him an apartment.
sentences.zh: 他说他在酒店里已经住了三个多月了，一直在等联邦紧急事务管理局（FEMA）帮他安排公寓。

sentences.en: Have you been moved from hotel to hotel since we talked?
sentences.zh: 自从我们上次通话后，你是不是一直在不同的酒店之间搬来搬去？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Oh my goodness.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: How many hotels?
sentences.zh: 住了多少家酒店了？

sentences.en: Two, and I actually ended up, because they made a mistake, and I ended up homeless for a night.
sentences.zh: 两家，而且实际上，因为他们弄错了，我甚至有一晚无家可归。

sentences.en: So, yeah, it's been hard for everyone.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这对每个人来说都很艰难。

sentences.en: And I'm not blaming FEMA or, you know, I know they don't know.
sentences.zh: 我并不是在责怪联邦紧急事务管理局，我知道他们也不知情。

sentences.en: But it is very hard for us.
sentences.zh: 但这对我们来说确实非常困难。

sentences.en: And it's really hard to live in a hotel room for that long.
sentences.zh: 在酒店房间里住那么久真的很痛苦。

sentences.en: You know, eating McDonald's every day is not the most, that's lifestyle.
sentences.zh: 你知道，每天吃麦当劳并不是什么，那算不上生活方式。

sentences.en: And also, like, if you leave your hotel room for more than two or three days and you lose that room, you know, so you can't even go and visit family.
sentences.zh: 而且，如果你离开酒店房间超过两三天，你就会失去那个房间，所以你甚至不能去探望家人。

sentences.en: You can't do anything.
sentences.zh: 你什么都做不了。

sentences.en: It really feels like we're in jail.
sentences.zh: 感觉真的像是在坐牢。

sentences.en: Do you do anything to give yourself some relief from just feeling stuck?
sentences.zh: 你有没有做些什么来缓解这种被困住的感觉？

sentences.en: Oh, I actually don't want to know absolutely nothing.
sentences.zh: 哦，我其实什么都不想做。

sentences.en: I'm just in my room every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都待在房间里。

sentences.en: You know, everyone's displaced.
sentences.zh: 你知道，大家都流离失所了。

sentences.en: Some of our friends are on the other side.
sentences.zh: 我们有些朋友在另一边。

sentences.en: And you're like, you know, you don't have a car.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，你没有车。

sentences.en: And, you know, it's kind of hard to just go to the beach by yourself.
sentences.zh: 所以，一个人去海滩有点困难。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's a weird feeling.
sentences.zh: 是啊，这是一种奇怪的感觉。

sentences.en: You know, I have multiple friends that move, love their job, love their home.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我有好几个朋友搬走了，他们热爱自己的工作，热爱自己的家。

sentences.en: I personally love my job as well because I was, I'm displaced.
sentences.zh: 我个人也很热爱我的工作，因为我，我流离失所了。

sentences.en: And, you know, a lot of us are still mourning and, you know, they're still in shock.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我们很多人还在哀悼，他们仍然处于震惊之中。

sentences.en: And they reopen for tourists.
sentences.zh: 但他们又重新向游客开放了。

sentences.en: But it's kind of like attending a funeral and you're having a party next door.
sentences.zh: 这感觉就像是在参加葬礼，而隔壁却在开派对。

sentences.en: Like you're walking and everyone's happy and everyone's drinking and, you know, and music.
sentences.zh: 就像你走在路上，每个人都很开心，都在喝酒，还有音乐。

sentences.en: And you're just there and you feel like a ghoSt.
sentences.zh: 而你就在那里，感觉自己像个幽灵。

sentences.en: Like not really in the mood.
sentences.zh: 感觉不太对劲。

sentences.en: So it's a weird feeling.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一种奇怪的感觉。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: It's going to be a long time before the high night gets back to how it was.
sentences.zh: 拉海纳要恢复到以前的样子还需要很长一段时间。

sentences.en: It's never going to be how it was.
sentences.zh: 它永远不会回到原来的样子了。

sentences.en: Did you ever find anything out about the pit bull that you tried to save?
sentences.zh: 你有没有打听到那只你试图救下的比特犬的消息？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: So my cat is still missing and then the pit bull is still missing.
sentences.zh: 我的猫还失踪着，那只比特犬也还失踪着。

sentences.en: I still have a little hope.
sentences.zh: 我仍然抱有一丝希望。

sentences.en: I know my friend, they just found her cat like a week ago.
sentences.zh: 我知道我的朋友，她们大概一周前才找回了她们的猫。

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, they're still finding a lot of pets.
sentences.zh: 是的，他们还在找回很多宠物。

sentences.en: So I don't know if my cat was as fortunate, but people are telling me not to lose hope.
sentences.zh: 所以我不知道我的猫是否也那么幸运，但人们告诉我不要放弃希望。

sentences.en: I hope they both turn up.
sentences.zh: 我希望它们都能回来。

sentences.en: Me too.
sentences.zh: 我也是。

sentences.en: Me too.
sentences.zh: 我也是。

sentences.en: I really hope so.
sentences.zh: 我真的希望如此。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Can you sort of envision what your ideal future or your ideal life would look like there in the coming months?
sentences.zh: 你能想象一下未来几个月你在那里的理想未来或理想生活是什么样的吗？

sentences.en: Well, it's hard because I was living my dream before all this happened.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这很难，因为在这一切发生之前，我正过着梦想中的生活。

sentences.en: So it's hard for me to think of a better situation than I had before, you know.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，很难想到比以前更好的情况了。

sentences.en: But I think my hope would be, you know, to get my place and then hopefully find my cat and then start moving on from there.
sentences.zh: 但我认为我的希望是，能有自己的住处，然后希望能找到我的猫，从那里开始继续生活。

sentences.en: It's just, it's kind of hard right now to imagine about anything.
sentences.zh: 只是，现在很难想象任何事情。

sentences.en: And that's the hardest part.
sentences.zh: 而那是最困难的部分。

sentences.en: The hardest thing is not to know.
sentences.zh: 最困难的就是未知。

sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目，我们要为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人感到宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种需要全黑环境才能睡觉的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they black out to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是说他们是不是睡着了就人事不省。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为那是非常具体的事情。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何播客平台上收听《Wirecutter秀》。

sentences.en: I'm just going to say that they're here.
sentences.zh: 我只想说他们在这儿。

sentences.en: You're going to sleep.
sentences.zh: 你要去睡觉了。

sentences.en: I'm just going to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我只是要去睡觉。
